codex.diaithir_nether.ash_soil.title: Ash Soil
codex.diaithir_nether.ash_soil.body: Fine grey soil covering the Ash Plains. Mined with a pickaxe.
codex.diaithir_nether.basalt_spire_stone: Dense dark stone forming spires. Counts as c:stones.
codex.diaithir_nether.ember_crystal_bloc: Glowing block crafted from four shards. Emits light level 12.
codex.diaithir_nether.ember_ore.title: Ember Ore
codex.diaithir_nether.ember_ore.body: Ore requiring an iron-tier pickaxe. Drops Ember Shards. Smelting a shard batch costs 100 J per quantum.
codex.diaithir_nether.ash_plains.title: Ash Plains
codex.diaithir_nether.ash_plains.body: A dry Nether biome of ash and drifting embers.
codex.diaithir_nether.crystal_cavern.bod: A glowing cavern biome rich in ember crystals.
codex.diaithir_nether.ember_ruin.title: Ember Ruin
codex.diaithir_nether.ember_ruin.body: A small ruined outpost found in custom Nether biomes.
codex.diaithir_nether.heat: Heat in the new Nether biomes is measured in kelvin; fire-immune creatures dwell where the ground stays above 400 K.
